blind.description: A stone pedestal supporting a golden sun idol or emblem. The pedestal is a tapered square stone column with stepped base and capital moldings in a light tan/beige sandstone texture. Resting on top of the pedestal is a vertical circular sun medallion featuring stylized blunt rays along the perimeter, a raised central golden dome on both sides, and painted concentric red and green accent rings. All geometry is solid, clean, and continuous with stylized hand-painted textures.
blind.from_above: From straight above, it presents a square stone capital and stepped base, topped by a thin vertical disc profile oriented vertically, with rounded rays projecting at the top and bottom and convex golden bosses bulging outward on either side.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 6 ft 6 in tall (slightly taller than the 5 ft 9 in scale figure), with a base footprint about 2 ft wide and deep.
